name: C54 "Luminalia" SMG
description: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. The Luminalia edition sports a festive red and green design.
